AI's Role in Education and the Importance of Teachers

The discourse surrounding artificial intelligence in education emphasizes the irreplaceable role of human teachers. While AI can automate tasks and provide personalized learning tools, it cannot replicate the empathy, critical thinking guidance, and emotional support that teachers offer. The integration of AI is seen as a tool to augment, not replace, the essential human element in the classroom, ensuring that education remains a holistic developmental process.
